messages:
Sanjay K.: Quick preflight for the marketplace listing — target go-live Thu 2025-10-12 09:00 PT. Need final assets/signoffs by Tue EOD PT. Main items to close:

1) Press release (final words + embargo) — @Zoe (PM)
2) Product blog post — @Maya (Content)
3) Landing page copy + hero image — @Liam (Design)
4) Partner quotes (HW + SI) — @Priya (Partner Ops)
5) Marketplace package metadata (SKU, icons, screenshots) — @deploy-bot / eng-platform
6) Integration docs + code samples — @Devon (Eng-Platform)
7) Tracking links / UTM + partner redirect — @marketing (cc @Maya)

Please ack and call out any blockers or timing conflicts.

Zoe (PM): Ack. PR is draft-ready, just one legal phrasing to confirm. Can we get legal eyes Mon by 2pm PT? I'll push to #legal. :eyes:

Maya (Content): Blog draft live: https://docs.google.com/d/xxx. Need product quote from @Sanjay and partner quote from @Priya to finalize. Proposed publish time to align with PR.

Priya (Partner Ops): Reached out to CloudWorks (SI) and NVID-Edge (HW). Tentative: quotes by Mon EOD if they sign off on the embargo. Asked for logos + partner-approved copy.

Liam (Design): Hero image in Figma: https://figma.com/file/yyy. Design needs 2x resolution PNG for marketplace requirements. Will export once copy is locked.

Devon (Eng-Platform): Integration sample (npm package + snippet) done, but packaging for the marketplace (manifest + icon sizes) needs the final metadata. I'll wait on SKU and screenshot assets. Also quick note: our sample includes token example — ensure we don't leak prod keys.

deploy-bot: Listing build job queued at 2025-10-12T16:00:00Z (job-id: lb-20251012-01). Reply "confirm" to lock the job.

Sanjay K.: Legal sprint — @Zoe please confirm when PR is in legal queue. Also tracking params we should use: utm_source=marketplace_partner&utm_medium=listing&utm_campaign=marketstore_q4. Maya, please add to blog CTAs.

Maya (Content): Agree on coordinated cadence: PR + blog + partner co-post at T0 (publish moment) then social & newsletter at T+30m. If partners want staggered posting, call it out now.

Priya (Partner Ops): Partners requested embargo lift windows. They'll approve only if final assets are in by Mon 12:00 PT. Please prioritize.

Liam (Design): Quick QA checklist for landing I'll run before export:
```
- CTA / trial link resolves
- Pricing table matches SKU
- Hero image loads at 2x
- Signup flow completes to /welcome
- Analytics events: marketplace_click, signup_complete
```

Zoe (PM): Legal confirmed the small phrasing change. PR queued — sending draft to @Sanjay for final sign-off now. :white_check_mark:

Devon (Eng-Platform): We'll own the post-launch monitoring with SRE. I'll create a minimal runbook in #incidents and add the tracing hooks. Will also coordinate a quick smoke test script to run immediately after the listing build job.

Sanjay K.: Great. Final asks before Tue EOD PT:
- Drop final PR link here (Zoe)
- Paste final blog link (Maya)
- Figma export + screenshot pack (Liam)
- Partner quotes + logos (Priya)
- Confirm listing job lock (respond to deploy-bot)
- Runbook link (Devon)

Once all assets are posted, I will schedule a final 15-min preflight sync Wed 09:30 PT to validate everything together. :rocket:
